branding.primaryColorUsage: Background colour for Forms theme and Outlook email headers

forms.themeImageConstraint: Do not upload the horizontal school logo as a Forms Style theme image; Forms applies it as cover wallpaper and crops brand text into a giant watermark.

email.headerLayout: Left white title (访客管理系统 / VISITOR MANAGEMENT + template heading); right crest image in a separate <td>

outlookWindowsWhiteTextFix.issue: Outlook for Windows (Word HTML) often renders header title text black when it shares a horizontal line with an crest, even when CSS color is white on Mac/OWA.
outlookWindowsWhiteTextFix.pattern: On the left title : color:#ffffff on the td and every div/p/span/strong; wrap title lines in ; use #ffffff not the keyword white; mso-line-height-rule:exactly on the title td; keep crest in a separate right .

qrCodePass.instructionZh: 请在到校时向校门安保人员出示此二维码进行快速核验放行。
qrCodePass.instructionEn: Please present this QR code to the gate security upon arrival.

visitorFacing.rule: Visitor form questions and visitor result emails must show Chinese first, then English.

guardFacing.rule: Gate views, guard SOPs, Teams channel cards, and emergency views must be written in clear Simplified Chinese.

adminInternal.rule: SharePoint internal names and Power Automate status values stay in English; Chinese is provided through labels, views, cards, and SOP text.

staffFacing.rule: Form A (internal invitation / visitor link request) is English-only for staff. Form B remains bilingual for external visitors.

formA.name: Request a Visitor Registration Link
formA.localeNote: English-only for staff; Form B remains bilingual for external visitors.

confirmationMessage.en: Thank you for your request. Your visitor registration link will be sent to your school email address. Please share it only with the intended visitor.

formB.name: 校园访客登记 / School Visitor Registration

visitorSafeguarding.responseEvidence: Microsoft Forms stores the required acknowledgement in the form response. No additional SharePoint column or Power Automate mapping is required for the current scope.

vis01.replaceManualTriggerWith: Microsoft Forms - When a new response is submitted
requiredActions: Office 365 Outlook - Send an email from a shared mailbox (V2)

expressions.expireAtNote: Visitor registration links remain valid for 24 hours from creation.

invitationReusePolicy.linkAvailableWhen: InviteCode matches AND InviteStatus = Created AND ExpireAt >= utcNow()
invitationReusePolicy.invitationStatusOwnership: InviteStatus represents link lifecycle only. It remains Created while usable and changes only to Expired, Cancelled, or Error.
invitationReusePolicy.applicationStatusOwnership: Approved and Rejected are written only to the current VisitorApplications item.
invitationReusePolicy.relationship: Many VisitorApplications rows may share one InvitationItemId and InviteCode.
invitationReusePolicy.legacyFieldRule: Do not write per-application values to these single-value VisitorInvitations fields.

idempotency.scope: Valid responses that reach VisitorApplications Create item
idempotency.duplicateBehavior: Create item still fails on the unique constraint before any duplicate approval, application update, or result email. The handled duplicate branch then terminates the run as Succeeded; non-FormsEventKey Create item failures remain Failed.

approvalIdentity.platformRule: Microsoft Approvals always shows the flow creator; an Exchange shared mailbox cannot be the Teams/Approvals sender identity.
approvalIdentity.recommendedCreator: A licensed Entra/M365 service user with display name School Visitor Management
approvalIdentity.sharedMailboxRole: Continue using visitor-workflow@example.com only for custom invitation, correction, invalid-link, result, and optional reminder emails.

approvalTimeoutPattern.status: Deferred future reminder design; this is not the current production timeout handler.
approvalTimeoutPattern.replace: Approvals - Start and wait for an approval
with: Parallel Branch A - Wait for an approval
Parallel Branch B - Delay PT24H, then remind when ApprovalStatus is still Pending

approvalTimeoutHandling.timeoutActionRunAfter: Start and wait for an approval = TimedOut
approvalTimeoutHandling.existingInFlightApprovals: Not cancelled or replayed by the 2026-08-20 repair.
approvalTimeoutHandling.verificationScope: Saved-definition and run-after structure only; a real 28-day timeout was not executed.

expressions.getInvitationFilter: InviteCode eq '<submittedInviteCode>' and InviteStatus eq 'Created' and ExpireAt ge utcNow()
expressions.approvedEmailParkingBehavior: Return an empty string when VehicleNo is empty; otherwise insert the bilingual designated school access road parking reminder before the existing Important block.

rules.name: expirePendingApplicationsAfterVisitDate
rules.then: ApprovalStatus = Expired; do not change the shared invitation because one application's state must not disable the link

rules.name: longStayReminder
rules.when: ApprovalStatus = Arrived AND ArrivalTime < addHours(utcNow(), -4) AND DepartureTime is empty
rules.then: Send Teams message to 异常处理 channel
